_comment: MultiHitBoxLib hitbox profile for orespawn:cryolophosaurus (ENT-S-173, hit boxes that follow the rigs, every species).
Generated by danger.orespawn.tools.hitbox.BossPartProfileWriter from cryolophosaurus.geo.json at the descriptor's adult render scale 0.5,

rest pose, body yaw 0; 3 parts grouped from the drawn bones by geometry (tools/hitbox_specs_from_rigs.py: touching bones merge while the union stays a compact square-footprint box the cubes fill, tiny bones fold into their neighbours, limb chains merge under the rig's cap, lateral slabs are padded for the flap): each part a box fitted
to the drawn cubes of its member bones, sized [max(x extent, z extent), y extent], synced to its largest member bone, the
pivot taken back through MHLib's rotation so the box sits on the drawn segment. Damage 1.0 on every part: the 1.7.10 mob
was one full-damage box, this aligns the hit boxes with the model and does not rebalance. main-hitbox has no size override,
so the movement and collision box stays the registered 1.7.10 0.75x0.75 box,
not pickable and taking no damage itself: every hit goes through a part. Parts are not solid (a mob is pushed, not stood on).
bone-sync-interval 2 (ENT-S-174): the master client sends the bone pose every second tick; in between,
the server carries the last pose along with the creature's movement. The four bosses keep the library's every tick.
